bestBets.overview: SUPERRIFIC ran well first up. He should have finished closer after being tightened late. He improves off that run and Pike retains the ride. GAINTREE ran well on debut in what has proved to be a strong race. She's been tuned up for her return with a sharp trial win. PROPERATA shook his maiden tag with a strong first-up win. This doesn't look a strong Saturday race and I'm expecting him to measure up. EXTREME DIXIE makes her debut on the back of two impressive 400m trials.

raceTips.comment: Gaintree was an impressive, quiet trial prior to running a cracker on debut in a fast run 1000m behind boom two year old filly Aurum Belle. Loved the trial leading into her return here and should get the right run from the draw. Think she’s a nice horse with a future. Properata broke through and won well on return over the 1000m after a hot trial leading in. Strong figure there but this is tougher and he’ll push forward with a bit of intent. Spinarella was pretty stiff at Bunbury last start in an all aged maiden and ran some handy races prior to that in 2YO company, love the map, Pearce’s have a strong hand. Superrific was a bit all over the place on debut but Pike sticking is certainly a positive.

BURNING BRIDGES had to work hard early to get across after drawing barrier 13/13 first-up. Kicked clear on straightening but hit a big brick wall at the 150m and ran out of petrol tickets. Second-up he’ll be fitter and he’ll be able to use the inside gate to his advantage to either lead or box seat. Expect they probably give him a kick to take up the running again and from there he should be in front for a long way at an eachway price. SUPERRIFIC beat him home in that event but in review did get the track into the race three deep cover? Would have preferred to see him at 1200 second-up? PROPERATA is only coming out of an All Age midweek maiden but won with authority. Really pinned the ears back and savaged the line late.

raceTips.comment: I LOVE YA MONEY went from a maiden straight into a 60+ Graduation and finished third to stablemate Supido Express. Love these 4-year-olds entering Westspeed Platinum grade for the first time and with Pike back aboard he’s the logical danger. ARTICOLE is improving with each run and can do it tough in his races. HEAVEN SPECIFIED will be better than Westspeed grade but the draw hurts.

Southern Firetail looks a really nice horse in the making. Loved the trial prior to a slashing first up run at 1400m where he’s gone under half a length in Saturday 3YO company. Now finds himself with only 1 additional kg on his back back into a Westspeed Platinum where he’s drawn to enjoy a midfield cover run from which he can then present on straightening, think he’ll be winning better races than this in time. I Love Ya Money took a big leap from a maiden win into Graduation company last start and couldn’t have gone bigger with the run that he had in transit. Pike back on and if he can slide across should have tactical field position on the favourite, another improving type. Articole hasn’t put a foot wrong this campaign, love how he’s going and attacking the line. Publicise was a huge run in review in defeat last start over the mile at Pinjarra behind Vexatious Rose but can mix her form.

bestBets.overview: WITH DISCRETION stepped up to a staying trip at his most recent start, with Pike going on, and he toyed with his rivals. It was an arrogant win and if he repeats that effort he'll make it back-to-back victories. KISSES FROM KELLY is rock-hard fit and in terrific form. He parks right over the speed and will give a strong kick.  OUR MATE ARCHIE is racing well and gives the impression he'll appreciate this rise in trip. SHIMONOSEKI has continually raised the bar this preparation and has claims.

raceTips.comment: With Discretion went 1400m straight to 2200m last start and went bang. Won soft as butter and won like a horse who could string 2-3 together in these Saturday staying events very easily. Might just need an ounce of luck in running given he’s drawn 1 but you’d argue Willie does some his best work from there. Shimonoseki is absolutely airborne since arriving here for Justine Erkelens and bumped into a very progressive mare last start in Western Miss. On trial at the trip but just love the way she’s knuckling down and finishing off her races and she’s got no weight on her back. Kisses From Kelly finds form and generally holds it, love the way he’s going and should just about be able to kick through, lead and control here. Chollima did Chollima things in defeat last start, always dangerous but impossible to catch.

SHIMONOSEKI has her first attempt over a staying trip since arriving in the West. She looks a stayer in the making – she settles brilliantly at the back of the field, she travels kindly under her rider and she works through her gears to sustain a big finishing run. She gets in perfectly on the 54kg minimum and if there is any bad luck or traffic issues for the odds-on favourite then she looks the horse who can capitalise. WITH DISCRETION won with his eyes closed last start. Was 1400 to 2200 and bolted in. Was the win of a horse who would put a fair few together in quick succession. Only real query is being 3 back fence, but in Pike we trust. OUR MATE ARCHIE will appreciate any wet weather on the horizon and is ready to test the waters at the distance. Was backed to beat Auto Cruise in a 72+ only two starts ago. Market loves the horse. KISSES FROM KELLY is as honest and consistent as they come.

bestBets.overview: TOO DARN STORMY burnt the punters last preparation, when he was a beaten favourite in all three starts. He attacks this fresh off a solid trial and this doesn't appear an overly strong race. MAI ALOHA is rock-hard fit and racing well. She will roll forward from her wide draw and give a big sight on the speed. NICCIMOTA is a speedy mare who resumes on the back of a big all-the-way trial win. LAST STYLEBENDER parks on the speed and gives a kick.

raceTips.comment: Sunset Session has progressed really quickly in a short period of time for a flying team Gangemi. 2nd first up over the 1000m behind a now Saturday 3YO winner in Tidwell, 2nd to Deepest Desire (dominant subsequent winner), broke maiden status posting a massive maiden winning figure with the 2nd horse Modern Girl since bolting in & had a hampered passage in the straight when 2nd to Flash Dancer last start at 1200m. Back to the 1000m, gets some weight relief and a map, think he’ll give another really strong account of himself. Eternal Wine should be suited with the speed profile of this race sitting back and looking to launch late, thought she was terrific in defeat last start. Last Stylebender is never far away in these races and can fire forward to look for the top. Too Darn Stormy resumes with the Pads applied which is never ideal and has had some reservations given the spruik around him for much of his career, first up in a fast run 1000m could be a good set-up for him but I won’t be with him until I see him go and do it again.

SUNSET SESSION took a while to break his maiden but gives the impression he’ll be competitive in whatever grade of race you step him up into. He went to 1200m last start and with an inch more galloping room on straightening he probably wins. Like him back to 1000m, tucked away behind the speed and being a son of Sessions he should relish any wet weather we get over the coming days. Stable going at 20% and 37% POT last 90 days. TOO DARN STORMY is a horse with ability but his fair share of issues. He’s now a 4 year old who hasn’t won since he won on debut as a 2 year old. In that 441 day period he has only had another 5 starts in an interrupted and disjointed career. If this was 1200m I’d happily go his way off a decent barrier trial, but at 1000m he might be vulnerable. LAST STYLEBENDER responded to the blinkers going on last start. In front for a long way. MAI ALOHA is leaving the gates brilliantly but looks destined to breeze this time?

bestBets.overview: ALL GRUNT found the line well first up. He'll improve off that run and appreciate the rise to 1600m. MT SHIRATAKU is hard fit and racing well. From his inside draw he parks right over the speed and gives a big kick. URQUHARTS BLUFF is racing well and should get every chance from gate four. LILLIAN can improve sharply at her second run back from a spell and Pike goes on.

raceTips.comment: Very open race. King Hit looks just about ready now third run back for the campaign. Loved his run fresh from barrier 15 of 15 getting home in comfortably the quickest L200m of the race despite never being in the hunt and thought his run in defeat last start behind Zourun Run had plenty of merit. Can slide forward here to sit a pair or two closer in running from a better draw out to the mile and think he looks over the odds at the double figures. Memory Parade is low flying, just needs a senior hoop for the kind of horse that he is! He was a bigger run than Mt Shirataku & All Grunt in defeat two starts ago and when you factor in the price differentials here, he looks over the odds as well if he was able to blend into the three wide line which you’d anticipate will build into this. Run last start was much better than it looks on paper. Mt Shirataku is in career best form and is thriving being ridden for speed, looks another very favourable set-up for him from a low draw and just runs for Lucy Fiore. All Grunt went super on return after really catching the eye at the trials prior to that, looks to have come back in very good order this campaign and the mile should only suit him better, would love to see him settle midfield no worse with cover as he can be a horse that really drifts back and doesn’t muster all that well on occasion early. Winning chances certainly don’t end there.

ALL GRUNT trialled up far better this time around than last campaign. Loved his first-up run in a ridiculously slowly run race (first 800m = 7L slower than average) and thought he did a super job to get within 2.5L of the winner late. With a 2.5kg swing in the weights, an extra furlong to wind-up and hopefully a touch more tempo in the race, thinking he can turn the tables on key rival MT SHIRATAKU who has gone from strength to strength and achieved what most horses don’t: graduating from Westspeed Platinum to 66+/72+ racing with success. Impossible to fault the way he’s going. KING HIT drew poorly first-up and second-up and yet ran well in both outings. He’s going far better than it might read on paper. GINGER GREEN is an old warrior and down in the weights with the senior rider on he’ll be there abouts. Doesn’t know how to run a bad race.

bestBets.overview: CINQUE STELLE suffered atrial fibrillation first up but was back to her best last start, producing a dominant win at Bunbury. She looks a highly talented mare on the rise and I expect her to take a stack of beating. TIDWELL won well last start in a fairly deep three-year-old event. He can stalk the speed from a good draw and run well. DELTASON is bursting to win a race. He'll park on the speed and give a kick. REFEMME NO ANGEL next best.

raceTips.comment: Tidwell was able to use his gate last start and get the job done in a pretty hot 3YO Saturday contest over 1400m where they’ve posted a really strong figure. This is no deeper, if not easier into Graduation company and he’s drawn perfectly once again, very respecting of the fav but would rather be with the proven commodity over the 1400m with a straightforward map at the price differential. Cinque Stelle had clear excuses first up before going back to the trials prior to a demolition job second up down at Bunbury. Let down like a proper horse to win soft as butter and now steps straight to 1400m drawn low as a horse whose ceiling clearly hasn’t been reached yet. Looks very progressive but also very sharp, 1400m and whether she’s as dynamic over the seven furlongs late will be interesting to watch. Just think she’s short enough at close to even money. Mardusa an improver third up, hasn’t had a lot go right thus far this prep. Supido Express broke through ridden with a sit last start and maps for a near on identical run here, stable flying.

TIDWELL was able to jump and use his barrier to advantage last start when he sat in the box seat and took the inside run presented to him on straightening to squeeze up inside of spruik filly Western Miss and hold off the late charge of Southern Firetail. Any time you’ve got a 3 year old 62+ winner dropping back into a 60+ Graduation it’s outstanding placement and he should be able to hold a nice spot midfield cover. Going super. CINQUE STELLE has only been beaten twice in her life: once over 1000m at the hands of Kings Court (went on to win another 3x races after) and first-up this campaign when she had atrial fibrillation. She’s stepping from 1100 to 1400m, that’s the only unknown. If she shows the same turn of foot at 1400m as she did last start at 1100m then she’s very exciting. DELTASON can’t buy a barrier. REFEMME NO ANGEL is still improving with every outing.

bestBets.overview: IMMORTAL BLISS was a forgive run in the H.G. Bolton Sprint. After getting back and wide in the run he was beaten less than a length. Prior to that he was a very impressive winner of the Beaufine. With normal luck in running, expect him to bounce back strongly. MADHI GIRL has been luckless in both starts this time in. From her wide gate she should get clear room to move and be attacking the line late. SNOWDOME will be peaking at his third run back. He will settle right over the speed and give a big kick. FLURO NEURO will be looking to replicate his fast-finishing win in the Bolton.

raceTips.comment: Tough edition of the Newmarket, many to make cases for. Snowdome was enormous the way he fought on in the HG Bolton to still run 2nd despite hitting a little flat spot once they rounded the home turn. Can press forward with some aggression here and third run back should really be ready to put in a peak performance for the prep. Like the fact he takes bad luck out of the equation. Immortal Bliss swept over them to win the Beaufine fresh and then had some excuses in the HG Bolton when never really finding a back throughout. Can blend in three deep with cover and be saved up to launch at them late. Jaz Session is a run you can completely rule a line through in the HG Bolton. Great return in the Beaufine and only better suited at 1200m, just might need an ounce of luck in running from the low draw. Madhi Girl was unlucky in the HG Bolton but how unlucky? Haven’t convinced myself she would have won had she got clear air from on straightening, could also be very wrong! Be some result in a very short period of time for the new owners if she were to salute. Chances don’t end there.

IMMORTAL BLISS was huge in the H.G Bolton. He endured a tough passage from start to finish and was left a sitting duck to be run down late. Thought all things considered he ran well into fifth placing and if he can lob three deep cover in the second half of the field here he’ll be hard to hold out late. He’s racing at the peak of his powers and gets through the conditions no worries. SNOWDOME hit a flat spot on straightening but worked through it to pick up again late. MADHI GIRL hasn’t seen any daylight so far this campaign. Barrier could be a blessing.

bestBets.overview: ZOURUN RUN is in terrific form this preparation. She'll just need some luck from her wide draw to go close again. COMMON TOUCH is a front-running type looking for his fourth straight win. From his inside draw he can fire straight to the lead and give a big sight again. ASIF has ability and attacks this fresh with the benefit of two strong trials. Pike takes the ride. MAGICAL SEQUENCE should get a lovely passage from a good draw and run well.

raceTips.comment: Common Touch is looking to make it 4 in a line for the prep but does get here a month between runs (with numerous suitable assigments in the programming over the last couple of weeks) which raises the question whether there has been a setback with him behind the scenes? Regardless, he’s just been re-programmed into a speed machine this campaign and has been running time in taking his rivals out of their comfort zones. This looks a great set-up for him to win again if he can find the front and march them once again and that form around Deep Lyric (which you can tie through Zourun Run) is really good form for a 66+. Asif has trialled up very well for his return and love the Pike booking carrying the 59.5kgs over the 1200m with freshness in the legs, he’s a quality galloper. Magical Sequence loses Pike after being posted off the course throughout last start in defeat, enjoys a much more economical trip in transit here and on map alone looks capable of bouncing back quickly in a big way. Zourun Run was the recipient of a Chris Parnham special last start, bit more against her here.

MAGICAL SEQUENCE had nothing go right last start. Not a mention in the Stewards Report but she was 3 deep the trip without cover. She gets a furlong of cover on the back of King Hit from the 600 to 400 when that galloper begins to make his move, but for 1200/1400m she’s three deep no cover. Back to 1200m, drawn to get a far more economical passage and while you lose Pike, you’re now going to get trip the price. Double figures for a mare with a 50% winning strike rate. COMMON TOUCH is looking to extend his winning run to four and progress from a maiden to a C1 to a 3 year old 62+ and now into a 66+. They’ve certainly figured out how to ride him and that’s to roll from the 600, use his high cruising speed and toughness to get rivals chasing and uncomfortable. This is a decent test for him and wary that by the end of the day the fence might not be the spot to be? ASIF trialled super for his return. ZOURUN RUN is a classy mare but barrier 11/12 and 59kg are both levellers.
